purpose: Exploratory engineering pilot; not a blind semantic translation benchmark
sample_rule: Opening Kamri-only span of each selected article; retain complete sentences up to 180 whitespace-delimited words, bounded by the indexed extract actually available. Do not replace unavailable inputs based on outcomes.
acquisition: FL indexed web-tool excerpts because direct host downloads are filtered; English raw HTML or archive OCR with content hashes
retrieval_protocol: Fixed collection containing five candidate works; bibliography and claimed source identity withheld from ranker. This is not open-web rediscovery.
evaluation: Report source ranking, reviewed passage links, lexical coverage, and positional-reference agreement only on analyst-marked equal-length compatible links. Positional-reference agreement is NOT independently verified semantic accuracy.
test_policy: One final run after implementation and synthetic verification. Subsequent changes must use a new run ID and acknowledge that this test has become development data.
limitations: Indexed extraction rather than raw FL HTML
Source candidates already nominated by a public report
No calibrated confidence or automatic claim acceptance
